verdict.note: The 0.10 threshold is calibrated on stochastic tile texture and does not transfer to a bevel. A bevel IS one large smooth volume, so it responds to light direction by design, and correlating that against an off-centre creature on a transparent field swings hard however clean the art is. The flat-normal control is 0.000, so the swing is the material and not the rig; and the height field never reads a pixel of tone, so it cannot be inverted the way luminance->Sobel can. Recorded, not blocking. What IS blocking on this path is drift: see tools/art/check.mjs.
